name: @orbb/notifications
description: Notification/reminder engine for ORBB (M6-B Lane A, B8): deterministic reminder-schedule computation over real measurement-task snapshots (types imported from @orbb/measurement) with upcoming-due reminders, missed-window detection, and the gentle REMIND -> REMIND_WITH_FALLBACK_OFFER escalation ladder whose fallback offer is DATA (the method vocabulary recorded on the task — the engine never orders a provider); preference-gated quiet hours (default 22:00-07:00 local-of-record, defer-to-edge, never silent drop); deterministic reminder identity f(task, window, rung, channel, UTC day) with a send-attempt ledger for exactly-once dispatch; a fail-closed NotificationChannel abstraction (typed send results, capability flags, SYNTH web-push/email provider doubles — no network, no SDKs); and PHI-free reminder payloads (ids + human-safe labels only) proven by not.toContain tests. Interface-driven: injected clock/id-factory/registries/ledger/directories; zero runtime dependencies.
